messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty auto-page triggered - high 5xx rate detected for gateway-service (us-central1). Incident PD-9876. Routing to #incidents and paging oncall.
pagerbot: PD-9876 -> ack required. Escalation timeout 10m. See alert: https://pd.example/PD-9876
kevin (oncall): Acked. I'm on it, checking graphs and logs now.
maria (sre): Thanks @kevin. Any signs of client auth issues or widespread customer impact?
kevin (oncall): Quick dump: sample log:
```
2026-03-17T03:12:10Z ERROR gateway-service: upstream="kv-proxy-02:504" msg="502 connection reset by peer" req=/v1/generate-stream
```
kevin (oncall): 5xx% jumped from ~0.3% to ~12% in 3m for /v1/generate-stream. Top failing upstream: kv-proxy-02.
raj (infra): Looking at infra - autoscaler didn't kick because nodepool quota hit. Requesting burst capacity now, but can we do a targeted restart of kv-proxy pods in us-central1a?
kevin (oncall): I'm going to restart the 2 suspect pods in that AZ.
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/kv-proxy --replicas=0 --selector=az=us-central1a
sleep 8
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/kv-proxy --replicas=2 --selector=az=us-central1a
```
kevin (oncall): restart started.
carmen (product-ops): Heads-up: support queue might get tickets for streaming failures; tagging as high priority and preparing comms if needed.
pagerbot: PD-9876 -> escalation: if incident not mitigated in 10m escalate to SRE-lead.
kevin (oncall): Temporary mitigation: diverting 20% of /v1/generate-stream traffic to model variant `stream-lite` (lower mem). Errors down to ~1.2% after diversion.
maria (sre): Good temporary fix. Any dedicated customers impacted (SLA risk)?
kevin (oncall): No dedicated tenant errors seen in logs, only public API traffic. Auth checks are clean.
raj (infra): Quota request for burst capacity approved, provisioning +2 nodes now. Also adjusted keepalive on nginx upstream to 60s (was 15s) and reloaded config.
kevin (oncall): nginx reload done. Monitoring spikes.
incident-bot: Update PD-9876: error-rate trending down 12% -> 1.1% over 7m. Status: acknowledged -> investigating -> mitigated (partial).
kevin (oncall): I'll monitor for 30m and then close if stable. Adding note to PD: mitigation = traffic diversion + targeted restart + keepalive tweak.
maria (sre): Please fill incident template and add impact summary + timeline (so we can decide postmortem). Assign follow-up to infra for quota/scale tuning.
kevin (oncall): Will do. PD-9876 set to mitigated, leaving open for follow-up/retro. @raj @maria thanks.
carmen (product-ops): Thanks team. I'll standby for any customer comms.
kevin (oncall): Closing check-in at +22min: metrics stable, 5xx at baseline. Will reopen if regressions.
